items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: So he looked at me and said, Nat, I said, what's the matter, Gene? He said, I don't read.

ctx.x: Gene Krupa jumped on the bandstand when he was with Benny Goodman. He thought he could kill David Allen. I said, babe, people looked at him like he was crazy. Two people applaud him. The same Gene Krupa. Gene Krupa don't know nothing about music. He can't read, huh?

I know he can't read. I'll bet he can't read. I thought he was going to Gene Krupa, right there by Kelly Stable. I told him. I said, I'm going to see how much music he knows. So he looked at me and said, Nat, I said, what's the matter, Gene? He said, I don't read. He didn't know that. I said, no, I'm sorry. But you hear him talk about music and press roll and all that stuff. He did not have press roll. Johnny, I know them, kid.
Dave Tuff. Gene Krupa was there one night. Look, Dave Tuff, that died.
